_readme: Live eval of the chat's understanding steps other than the agent (go test -tags liveeval -run TestChatParseEval .; see chat_parse_eval_test.go).

step: parse (ParseTask, the production prompt aiTaskParserSystemPrompt), split (SplitErrands), purchase (NeedsPurchase), classify (Classify). input is what the router sends: for a re-draft, every line said so far, one per line.

parse checks: category (any of), loc1 / loc2 (substring, case-insensitive; "" = must be empty), scheduled, description (every substring), title_not (no substring). UNSAFE: scheduled wrong (books at the wrong time), a stop invented where none was given, or a status word in the title (read as a withdrawal and dropped, notes.go / statusWordAdded). Anything else wrong is FAIL.
Phone numbers in production messages are replaced by fictional 555 numbers.
